en.html:
—That.

Last instant.

My understanding had fallen completely behind.

The enemy, and myself—I looked down upon both only after the whole thing was over. Wah. Such punctual awareness.

This time, a perfectly fatal, annihilating Falling Down—Ladybug.

I had not sensed that catastrophe coming. On this much I could give a definite answer.

But my limbs had moved.

Sprung into action as though answering it.

Why? That answer I did not have.

I had been struggling for force, for speed. Perhaps, by chance, the two things had coincided.

Perhaps they had not.

The reason, I did not know.

Whatever the reason, at that instant I had done it.

en.html:
...Yes.

What Silver Star's eyes had said was correct.

Godlike attack speed. Very good. First survive long enough to use it, na. Crush the body before that, and what use was the attack?

She had locked on to the whole of me, armor and all. She could read the instant I began my electromagnetic draw and win before it.

An ordinary warrior could not do this. Silver Star could. No doubt whatsoever on that point.

Meanwhile, from our side, not even the enemy's shadow could be caught.

Even if she gave me time to draw, my edge would probably never reach her armor.

Such a treasure I had. So completely useless I had made it.

Of no use at all.

————Yes. Exactly.

Drawing the sword was of no use.

……そうだ。
　銀星号の<ruby>眸<rt>め</rt></ruby>が語った事は、当を得ている。

　神速の攻撃手段を持っていようと――
　使う前に<ruby>本体<rt>・・</rt></ruby>が潰されては何の意味もない。

　<ruby>騎体<rt>おれ</rt></ruby>自身が完全に銀星号から<ruby>捕捉<rt>ロックオン</rt></ruby>されている以上、
銀星号は俺が電磁抜刀を繰り出す機を読み取り、それ
に先んじて勝を制する事ができる。
　並みの武人には無理でも、銀星号なら必ずできる。

　対してこちらは敵の影も捉えられない。
　例え抜刀の余暇を与えられようとも、刃先が敵騎に
届く事は無いだろう。

　つまりは宝の持ち腐れだ。
　何の役にも立たない。

　――――そう。その通りだ。
　<ruby>抜刀では意味が無いのだ<rt>・・・・・・・・・・・</rt></ruby>。
